title: ORDER BY sorts a column by its own values, not by its sort-by column

source.quote: Sort by column property in semantic models do not apply to DAX query results.
source.supports: the model sort-by column is not used by ORDER BY

derivation: Date[Month] holds Jan, Feb, Dec, Jan, Feb, Mar: four distinct values. It is sorted by MonthNo in the model, but the query sorts the text: Dec, Feb, Jan, Mar. By MonthNo it would be Jan, Feb, Mar, Dec.
